'''Elricain Tavolin''' is an officer under the command of [[Aldrin Caldevwin]] in the [[Cairhienin]] army. His banner bears two crossed white bars.

== Appearance ==
His hair is shaved in the fashion of a Cairhienin soldier.

== Activities ==
He is assigned by [[Aldrin Caldevwin]] to be [[Rand al'Thor]]'s escort during Rand's ride to [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|2|21}} He brings Rand to a gatehouse to register upon arriving.{{ref/book|2|25}}
